newsitem.title: SWEDEN: New Volvo boss sees room for alliances.
newsitem.headline: New Volvo boss sees room for alliances.

text.p: New Volvo managing director Leif Johansson told Reuters Financial Television in an interview on Monday that he would exclude major merger plans for Volvo like the failed alliance with France's Renault.
Johansson said however that he would not rule out alliances or networking and that he saw potential for developing the type of platform-sharing alliances Volvo currently has with Japan's Mitsubishi.
Asked if he would rule out a Renault-type merger, Johansson replied:

"I think I would with my information today. I would rule out giant mergers like the one with Renault but I would not rule out any type of networking or alliance when it comes to making components or critical componentry or even sharing platforms like what we are already doing with Mitsubishi."
On cooperation with Mitsubishi, which involved trucks and cars, Johansson said: "I certainly see potential for developing those types of alliances...and that way of thinking."
Mitsubishi has frequently been mentioned as a future cooperation partner for Volvo.
